mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in total demand (GDPC1) signals rising economic activity, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05 over any 1-year window, or 60-day returns in expanding economies are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals rising labor costs and inflation expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 4.5%, or returns revert in subsequent periods.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in demand (GDPC1) and falling federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) create a favorable macro environment, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days of the signal.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both proxies move in expected directions, or the combination fails to predict returns in subsequent periods.

mechanism_narrative: Surge in monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 150k signals robust labor market strength, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS crosses above 150k, or returns revert in subsequent periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the supply index (INDPRO) reflects expanding production capacity, fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 60-day returns in expanding economies are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a surge in federal funds rates above 4.5% signals higher borrowing costs, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5%, or returns revert in subsequent periods within the tightening regime.

mechanism_narrative: Combined expansion in supply (INDPRO) and easing monetary policy (FEDFUNDS decline) creates a favorable macro environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days of the signal.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both proxies move in expected directions, or the combination fails to predict returns in subsequent periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals tight labor markets, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses below 3.5%, or returns revert in subsequent periods.
